conflicts.c1_badge: Conflict 1 Resolved: Virtual Viewport + Rate Limit Engine
conflicts.c1_summary: Ops team requested 1 page with no pagination clicks, while API enforces 25 items/req and 5 req/min. Solved via a single scrollable viewport, progressive buffer queue, and rate-limit throttle with honest status.
conflicts.c2_badge: Conflict 2 Resolved: Multi-Modal Accessible Status Indicator
conflicts.c2_summary: Designer wanted dot only; WCAG 1.4.1 forbids color as the only visual cue. Solved with semantic SVG geometric icons + color + tooltips + screen-reader labels.
